narrative: 过程、记忆、一个正在被构思出来的故事：手和眼睛可以比整个房间拍得更紧。底下有摄影结构支撑，所以它依然是一个人物的镜头。
油画布风（Canvas）是颜料。素描风则是那之前的一步。
当你需要完成的油画、奢侈品广告般的精致，或完整的动画时，它就是错误的工具。如果没有反复探索的线条，那只是一幅插画，而不是素描。
how: 人像距离，50mm到85mm焦段，固定机位。纸张的白色作为高光，石墨或墨线，阴影处的排线。
不要把它完成成一幅干净的插画。Prompt: Sketch treatment of [Subject], line, paper tooth, unfinished hatching, a drawing that still looks.
when: 一张过程静帧、一段正在被绘制出来的记忆、一个尚未完成的故事。不要把它当作干净的矢量封面来用。
vs: 油画布风是带有笔刷痕迹和画布纹理的油画。动画（Animation）可能从头到尾都是手绘运动。
素描风是纸上未完成的线条，底下有摄影结构。手绘风（Hand Paint）是正在进行中的湿润色彩。
examples_film: 《和巴什尔跳华尔兹》（Waltz with Bashir）把手绘线条当作鲜活的拍摄素材来使用。《至爱梵高·星空之谜》（Loving Vincent）中的习作展现了油画之前的那一步。
未完成就是重点。这是语法，而不是要照搬的某一页。
mistakes: 一幅干净的矢量肖像，或一幅完成的油画布风作品。破绽是没有反复探索的线条。
修正方法：排线、留白的纸张、未完成的轮廓线，以及一张依然清晰可辨的脸。

faq.q: 电影中的素描风（Sketch）是什么？
faq.a: 一种上色之前的配方：线条、纸张纹理、未完成的排线，一幅依然能被读解为一个人的画。未完成是必须的。

faq.q: 素描风（Sketch）与油画布风（Canvas）的区别
faq.a: 油画布风是完成的油画。素描风止步于线条和排线。如果你看到笔刷痕迹和湿润的高光，你想要的是油画布风。
过程、记忆、构思。跳过奢侈品封面和完成的画廊静照。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写素描风的提示词？
faq.a: 先写人像距离的固定机位，然后要求反复探索的线条和留白的纸张。

narrative: Process, memory, a story being invented: hands and eyes can be tighter than the room. Photographic structure sits underneath so it remains a shot of a person.
Canvas is paint. Sketch is the step before.
It is the wrong tool when you need finished oil, luxury-ad polish, or full animation. If there are no searching lines, it is an illustration, not a sketch.
how: Portrait distance, 50mm to 85mm, lock-off. Paper-white as the highlight, graphite or ink line, hatching in shadow.
Do not finish into a clean illustration. Prompt: Sketch treatment of [Subject], line, paper tooth, unfinished hatching, a drawing that still looks.
when: A process still, a memory being drawn, a story that is not finished. Do not use it as a clean vector cover.
vs: Canvas is oil with bristle and tooth. Animation may be drawn throughout as motion.
Sketch is unfinished line on paper, photographic structure underneath. Hand Paint is wet color in the act.
examples_film: Waltz with Bashir uses drawn line as living coverage. Loving Vincent 's studies show the step before oil.
Unfinished is the point. Grammar, not a page to copy.
mistakes: A clean vector portrait, or a finished Canvas. The tell is no searching line.
Fix it: hatching, reserved paper, unfinished contours, a face that still looks.

faq.a: A pre-paint recipe: line, paper tooth, unfinished hatching, a drawing that still reads as a person. Unfinished is required.
Canvas is finished oil. Sketch stops at line and hatching. If you see bristle and wet lights, you wanted canvas.
Process, memory, invention. Skip luxury covers and finished gallery stills.

faq.q: How do I prompt Sketch for AI image or video?
faq.a: Portrait lock-off, then: Sketch treatment of [Subject], line, paper tooth, unfinished hatching, a drawing that still looks. Demand searching lines and reserved paper.
